title: Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 29 U.S.C. 2101. The Short Title note says the Act, which enacted the chapter, 'may be cited as the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act'.
notes: Requires 60 days' notice of plant closings and mass layoffs. Employment is at-will under state law, and there is no federal statutory severance entitlement. Severance plans may fall under ERISA.
